properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 6 at 9:36PM MDT until August 6 at 10:00PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 935 PM MDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 6 miles east of Campo to 17 miles southwest of
Stonington, moving southeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Golf ball size hail and 60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail
damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles.

Locations impacted include...
Campo and open country east of Campo.
